svg.aria-label: The Arsenal: PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, FAISS, FastAPI, Docker, Python and more
svg.title: The Arsenal: PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, FAISS, FastAPI, Docker, Python and more

section.style: padding: 32px 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px

div.style: display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; border-bottom: 3px solid #16110e; padding-bottom: 8px

h3.style: margin: 0; font-family: 'Rozha One', serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 40px; line-height: 1

span.style: font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase

div.span: Tools used in the chapters above
